reasoning_content:
The docker daemon seems to have gone down, or the connection to docker is flaky. Interestingly the error mentions Podman, SSH handshake to wsarecv remote host - that's a Windows path indicator... Actually this container might be running rootless docker via a remote/podman. The daemon became unreachable while a huge build was running (memory pressure! Running many npm ci + playwright chromium with 7.6GB RAM likely OOM-killed the docker daemon).

Let me check if the docker daemon can be restarted.

action.command: ps aux | grep -iE "dockerd|containerd|podman" | grep -v grep | head; echo "---"; ls -la /var/run/docker.sock 2>&1; cat /etc/os-release | head -3

tool_call.name: terminal
